questions.question: List out any two objectives of organizing?
questions.solution_html:
•  Identifying the tasks that must be performed and grouping them whenever necessary
  •  Assigning these tasks to the personnel while defining their authority and responsibility.
  •  Delegating this authority to these employees
  •  Establishing a relationship between authority and responsibility
  •  Coordinating these activities.
  • Future Oriented
  • Executive Development
  • Reduction in Resistance to Change
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: What is the meaning of Supervision?
questions.solution_html:
• Supervision is direction, guidance and control of working force with a view to see that they are
  • working according to plan and are keeping time schedule.
  • Goal Oriented
  • Career Planning and Development
  • Reduction of Employee Turnover and Absenteeism

questions.question: Explain the functions and components of HRD.
questions.solution_html:
• Flexible
  • HRD is defined as activities and process undertaken by an organisation to formulate the
  • intellectual, moral, psychological, cultural, social and economic development of the
  • individuals in an organisation, in order to help them to achieve the highest human potential as
  • a resource for the community.
  • The important functions of human resource development (HRD) are as follows
  • Involvement in Worker’s Participation
  • in Management
  • Achievement of Goals

questions.question: Evaluate how leadership affects employee morale and teamwork.
questions.solution_html:
• Leadership shapes the entire workplace culture, from setting values and expectations to creating a
  • supportive environment where employees feel heard, valued, and motivated to collaborate
  • effectively.
  • Fosters a culture of trust and respect
  • Empowers and recognizes employees
  • Encourages open communication
  • Supports professional growth
  • Promotes well-being
  • Development of Friendly Relationships

questions.question: Define motivation and explain its importance in the workplace.
questions.solution_html:
• Motivation is the word derived from the word ’motive’ which means needs, desires, wants or drives
  • within the individuals. It is the process of stimulating people to actions to accomplish the goals. In
  • the work goal context the psychological factors stimulating the people’s behaviour can be - desire
  • for money,success,recognition,job-satisfaction,team work, etc .
  • The importance of motivation can be studied under the following heads
  • Better Industrial Relations
